posts.zh:
win11-oneocr 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 的本地 Windows 11 OneOCR 工具：`oneocr_recognize` 返回 OCR 文本，以及包含行/词多边形、置信度、旋转角度和手写体样式的结构化结果。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e0584596f12b849a79cc.html
posts.en:
win11-oneocr is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Local Windows 11 OneOCR tool for DSH: `oneocr_recognize` returns OCR text and structured line/word polygons, confidence, rotation, and handwriting style.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e0584596f12b849a79cc.html
